sources.snippet: The MuJoCo file scene.xml supports two differenly calibrated SO101 robot files: New Calibration (Default): Each joint's virtual zero is set to the middle of its joint range. Use -> so101_new_calib.xml. Old Calibration: Each joint's virtual zero is set to the configuration where the robot is fully extended horizontally. Use -> so101_old_calib.xml. sources.title: Train an SO-101 Robot From Sim-to-Real With NVIDIA Isaac
sources.snippet: You'll train and deploy a vision-language-action (VLA) model to perform unstructured pick-and-place of centrifuge vials into a rack using an SO-101 robot arm - first in sim, where we can iterate quickly and validate behavior, then in reality.
